description: This file 'inst_sel_vector.c' contains implementation for managing vectors of instance number selectors used for permission control based on instances within a data model. It includes functions for initialization, cleanup, adding/removing entries, and computing permissions based on instance matching logic, indicating it's part of permission or access control logic specific to instance-based selections.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Init(inst_sel_vector_t * isv)
methods.description: Initializes the instance selector vector structure by setting its internal pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Destroy(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,bool destroy_entries)
methods.description: Deinitializes and frees resources associated with the vector; optionally destroys individual entries if owned.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Unwatch(inst_sel_vector_t * isv)
methods.description: Unwatches all selectors currently being watched within the vector.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Fill(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,int num_entries,unsigned short permission_bitmask)
methods.description: Populates the vector with a specified number of entries, initialized with wildcards and a permission bitmask.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Add(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,inst_sel_t * sel)
methods.description: Adds a new selector to the vector.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Remove(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,int index,bool destroy_entries)
methods.description: Removes the selector at a specified index, freeing resources if required.

methods.name: int INST_SEL_VECTOR_Find(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,inst_sel_t * sel)
methods.description: Finds the index of a specific selector in the vector.

methods.name: unsigned short INST_SEL_VECTOR_GetPermissionForInstance(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,dm_instances_t * inst,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Calculates the permissions bitmask for a given set of instance identifiers based on selectors in the vector.

methods.name: bool DoPermissionInstancesMatch(inst_sel_t * sel,dm_instances_t * inst,bool * again,unsigned flags)
